title: Gods Coloring Book
original_lyrics:
[verse]
Today as I was walking in the fields just down the way
I sat down on fallen log to pass the time away
And as I looked around me the more that I did look
The more I realized that I was viewing God's coloring book
I saw golden ray of sunlight silver drop of dew
soft white floating cloud sailing across the sky of blue
yellow dandelion pretty evergreen
And some red and orange flowers growing wild along the stream
And the more I look around me the more that I do look
The more I realize that I was viewing God's coloring book
The grain of sand in an old man's hair the pink in baby's cheeks
The blackness in stormy sky the brown in fallen leaves
And the multicolored rainbow stretched across the sky
And the purple haze at sunset just before the night
And the more I look around me the more that I do look
The more I realize that I was viewing God's coloring book
Then I turn my face toward the sky and say silent prayer
Though God doesn't speak to me I see Him everywhere
He is all around me He's everywhere I look
And each new day is but new page in God's coloring book
Yes each new day is but new page in God's coloring book
